newsitem.title: RUSSIA: RUSSIA'S OMSK REGION PLANS EUROBOND ISSUE IN 1998.
newsitem.headline: RUSSIA'S OMSK REGION PLANS EUROBOND ISSUE IN 1998.

text.p: Russia's Omsk region, located in Siberia, plans to tap the Eurobond market in 1998, the deputy governor of the region said on Wednesday.
"We intend to issue Eurobonds next year, but no terms have been set yet," Alexander Korotkov told a news conference.
He said the regional administration proposed that several Russian banks apply to help organise the issue. He said one of Russia's biggest banks, Menatep, had said it was ready to organise the issue.
Omsk region joins an 18-long queue of Russian regions, cities and republics preparing Eurobond issues, which they see as a cheaper form of credit than domestic borrowing.
